## Imports
```{python}
import numpy as np
import polars as pl
from pyprojroot.here import here

## To fix format of PDF output
pl.Config.set_tbl_cols(8)    ## show at most 8 columns (first 4 and last 4)
pl.Config.set_tbl_rows(6)    ## show at most 6 rows
```

## Combining the Referee Stats Files Into One Table
```{python}
seasons = ['2017-2018', '2018-2019', '2019-2020', '2020-2021', '2021-2022', '2022-2023', '2023-2024', '2024-2025', '2025-2026']

refList = []
for s in seasons:
    fileName = f'nba_referee_stats_{s}.csv'
    if s == '2025-2026':
        fileName = 'nba_referee_stats_2025_2026.csv' ## uses an underscore instead of dash between years
    
    refSeason = pl.read_csv(here(f'Data/{fileName}'))

## find foul differential column
    diffCol = [c for c in refSeason.columns if 'FOUL DIFFERENTIAL' in c][0]

    refSeason = (refSeason
        .rename({diffCol: 'foul_diff'})
        .rename({'TYPE': 'ROLE'}, strict = False) ## older files say TYPE
        .drop(['RANK', 'Unnamed: 13'], strict = False) ## empty columns
        .with_columns(Season = pl.lit(s)) ## adds Season if missing
        )
    refList.append(refSeason)

## Stack all seasons
refStats = pl.concat(refList, how = 'diagonal')

## Renaming columns
refStats = refStats.rename({
    'Season': 'season', 'REFEREE': 'referee', 'ROLE': 'role', 'GENDER': 'gender', 'EXPERIENCE (YEARS)': 'experience', 'GAMES OFFICIATED': 'games', 'HOME TEAM WIN%': 'home_win_pct', 'HOME TEAM POINTS DIFFERENTIAL': 'home_pt_diff', 'TOTAL POINTS PER GAME': 'points_per_game', 'CALLED FOULS PER GAME': 'fouls_per_game', 'FOUL% AGAINST ROAD TEAMS': 'foul_pct_road', 'FOUL% AGAINST HOME TEAMS': 'foul_pct_home',
})

## Fixing percents
refStats = refStats.with_columns(
    pl.when(pl.col(c) > 1).then(pl.col(c) / 100).otherwise(pl.col(c)).alias(c)
    for c in ['foul_pct_road', 'foul_pct_home']
)

refStats
```

## Combine CHEIF and CREW Rows
```{python}
avgCols = ['home_win_pct', 'home_pt_diff', 'points_per_game', 'fouls_per_game', 'foul_pct_road', 'foul_pct_home', 'foul_diff']

refStats = (refStats
    .group_by(['season', 'referee']) ## referee rows for a season together
    .agg(
        experience = pl.col('experience').max(),
        gender = pl.col('gender').first(),
        games = pl.col('games').sum(), ## adding them
        *[((pl.col(c) * pl.col('games')).sum() / pl.col('games').sum()).alias(c) for c in avgCols] ## weighted average for every column in avgCols
    )
    .sort(['season', 'referee'])
)
refStats
```

## Cleaning Games File
```{python}
games = pl.read_csv(here('Data/nba_games_ref_assignments.csv'))

games = (games
    ## Spliting season code (22025 --> game type 2, start year 2025)
    .with_columns(
        game_type = pl.col('season') // 10000,
        start_year = pl.col('season') % 10000,
    )
    ## Make it look like the referee table above ('2025-2026')
    .with_columns(
        season = pl.col('start_year').cast(pl.String) + '-' + (pl.col('start_year') + 1).cast(pl.String)
    )
    ## Keep only regular season games (2017-18)
    .filter(pl.col('game_type') == 2, pl.col('start_year') >= 2017)
    ## Fix team names
    .with_columns(
        pl.col(['home_team', 'away_team']).str.replace('L.A.', 'LA', literal=True)
    )
    ## Remove games listed twice
    .unique(subset = 'game_id', keep = 'first', maintain_order=True)
    ## Remove games missing refrees
    .drop_nulls(subset = ['official1', 'official2', 'official3'])
    ## Drop 4th referee column (empty during reg season)
    .drop(['official4', 'official4_code', 'official4_JNum'])
)
games.shape
```

## Matching Referee Stats to Games File - Fixing Names
```{python}
## Referee Name fixed
nameFix = {
    'J.T. Orr': 'JT Orr',
    'Sharae Mitchell': "Sha'Rae Mitchell", 'ShaRae Mitchell': "Sha'Rae Mitchell",
    'Pat OConnell': "Pat O'Connell", 'PAT OConnell': "Pat O'Connell", "PAT O'Connell": "Pat O'Connell",
    'Cheryl Flores': 'Che Flores',
    'Jamahl Ralls': 'JD Ralls',
    'CP Painter': 'Chelisa Painter',
}
refStats = refStats.with_columns(pl.col('referee').replace(nameFix))

## One row per referee per game, attaching stats
gameRefs = (games
    .unpivot(index = ['game_id', 'season'], on = ['official1', 'official2', 'official3'],
        variable_name = 'slot', value_name = 'referee')
    .with_columns(pl.col('referee').replace(nameFix))
    .join(refStats, on = ['season', 'referee'], how = 'left')
)
## Check - should be 0
gameRefs['fouls_per_game'].null_count()
```

## Average 3 Referees and Attach Games
```{python}
crewStats = (gameRefs
    .group_by('game_id')
    .agg(
        crew_fouls_per_game = pl.col('fouls_per_game').mean(),
        crew_experience = pl.col('experience').mean(),
        crew_foul_diff = pl.col('foul_diff').mean(),
        crew_home_win_pct = pl.col('home_win_pct').mean(),
    )
)

## Attaching stats to games _TranslateTable
games = games.join(crewStats, on = 'game_id', how = 'left')
games
```

## Attaching Team Fouls File
```{python}
teamFouls = (pl.read_csv(here('Data/nba_team_personal_fouls_per_game_2017_2025.csv'))
    .with_columns(pl.col('team').replace({'Okla City': 'Oklahoma City'}))
)

## Attaching twice (one for home and one for away)
games = (games
    .join(teamFouls.rename({'team': 'home_team', 'personal_fouls_per_game': 'home_team_fouls'}), on = ['season', 'home_team'], how = 'left')
    .join(teamFouls.rename({'team': 'away_team', 'personal_fouls_per_game': 'away_team_fouls'}), on = ['season', 'away_team'], how = 'left')
)
games

## Expecting that 1,230 games from 2025-26 will have blanks for two columns -- because team fouls file stops at 2024-25
games.filter(pl.col('home_team_fouls').is_null()).group_by('season').len()
```

### Each row is one game with game info (date, season, teams), crew stats (avg of the 3 referees), and home/away team foul avgs.

## Reading Commented Out Above and Saving
```{python}
gameLogs = pl.read_csv(here('Data/nba_team_game_logs.csv'))
gameLogs['MIN'].value_counts().sort('MIN')
```

## Total Fouls Per Game, Then Join
```{python}
totalFouls = (gameLogs
    .with_columns(game_id = pl.col('GAME_ID').cast(pl.Int64)) ## 0021700001 --> 21700001
    .group_by('game_id')
    .agg(
        total_fouls = pl.col('PF').sum(),
        n_teams = pl.len(), ## about 2 every game
        game_minutes = pl.col('MIN').max(),
    )
)

## Attach to games
games = games.join(totalFouls, on = 'game_id', how = 'left')
games
```

## Team Season Avg From gameLogs
```{python}
teamSeasonFouls = (gameLogs
    ## Get season from game ID
    .with_columns(start_year = 2000 + (pl.col('GAME_ID') // 100000) % 100)
    .with_columns(
        season = pl.col('start_year').cast(pl.String) + '-' + (pl.col('start_year') + 1).cast(pl.String)
    )
    ## Average fouls per game for each team in season
    .group_by(['season', 'TEAM_ABBREVIATION'])
    .agg(team_fouls = pl.col('PF').mean())
)
teamSeasonFouls
```

## Swap Out Old Columns For New
```{python}
games = (games
    .drop(['home_team_fouls', 'away_team_fouls']) ## remove old ones (blanks)
    .join(teamSeasonFouls.rename({'TEAM_ABBREVIATION': 'home_team_abbr', 'team_fouls': 'home_team_fouls'}), on = ['season', 'home_team_abbr'], how = 'left')
    .join(teamSeasonFouls.rename({'TEAM_ABBREVIATION': 'away_team_abbr', 'team_fouls': 'away_team_fouls'}), on = ['season', 'away_team_abbr'], how = 'left')
)
games.select(pl.col('home_team_fouls', 'away_team_fouls').null_count())
```

All files combined into one table (games). There's 10,729 games, each with crew stats, team foul avgs, and total_fouls (target number).

## Removing Unuseful Columns
```{python}
gamesClean = (games
    .with_columns(game_date = pl.col('game_date').str.to_date('%m/%d/%Y')) ## Changing date format
    ## Overtime periods and late season
    .with_columns(
        overtime = ((pl.col('game_minutes') - 240) /25).cast(pl.Int64),
        days_left = (pl.col('game_date').max().over('season') - pl.col('game_date')).dt.total_days(),
    )
    .with_columns(late_season = pl.col('days_left') <= 14)
    .select(
        'game_id', 'game_date', 'season', 'home_team_abbr', 'away_team_abbr', 'official1', 'official2', 'official3', 'crew_fouls_per_game', 'crew_experience', 'crew_foul_diff', 'crew_home_win_pct', 'home_team_fouls', 'away_team_fouls', 'overtime', 'late_season', 'total_fouls' ## Only keeping useful columns
    )
    .sort('game_date')
)
gamesClean.write_parquet(here('Data/nba_games_clean.parquet'))
gamesClean
```


# EDA

## Histogram of Total Fouls
```{python}
from plotnine import *
import pyarrow

(ggplot(gamesClean, aes(x = 'total_fouls'))
    + geom_histogram(binwidth=1)
    + labs(x = 'Total fouls in game', y = 'Number of games', title = 'Distribution of Total Fouls Per Game')
)
```

## Look at Unusual Games
```{python}
gamesClean['total_fouls'].describe()
```

## Games With Fewest and Most Fouls
```{python}
## Lowest
gamesClean.sort('total_fouls').select('game_date', 'home_team_abbr', 'away_team_abbr', 'total_fouls').head(10)
```

```{python}
## Highest
gamesClean.sort('total_fouls', descending=True).select('game_date', 'home_team_abbr', 'away_team_abbr', 'total_fouls').head(10)
```

## Fouls Over Time
```{python}
(ggplot(gamesClean, aes(x = 'season', y = 'total_fouls'))
    + geom_boxplot()
    + labs(x = 'Season', y = 'Total fouls in game', title = 'Total Fouls Per Game by Season')
    + theme(axis_text_x = element_text(rotation = 45, ha = 'right'))
)
```

## Does The Crew Actually Matter
```{python}
(ggplot(gamesClean, aes(x = 'crew_fouls_per_game', y = 'total_fouls'))
    + geom_point(alpha = 0.1)
    + geom_smooth(method = 'lm', color = 'red')
    + labs(x = 'Crew average fouls per game (season)', y = 'Total fouls in game', title = 'Crew Foul Tendency vs. Total Fouls')
)
```

## Correlations

```{python}
gamesClean.select(
    'total_fouls', 'crew_fouls_per_game', 'crew_experience', 'crew_foul_diff',
    'crew_home_win_pct', 'home_team_fouls', 'away_team_fouls', 'overtime'
).corr()
```
